issues.issue_title: Missing llms.txt File for Generative AI Engine Optimization (AEO)
issues.observed_problem: HTTP GET to https://incubrix.com/llms.txt returns 404 NOT_FOUND. AI search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Claude) cannot efficiently parse the product capabilities, pricing, and architecture.
issues.evidence: HTTP 404 response on https://incubrix.com/llms.txt with Cloudflare/Vercel error header.
issues.recommended_solution: Deploy a standardized /llms.txt markdown file at the root domain detailing IncuBrix Creator Studio capabilities, pricing, and canonical URLs.
issues.ready_to_paste_code:
# IncuBrix Creator Studio

> Create With Purpose. Publish Without Limits.

IncuBrix turns one content into clips, captions, voiceovers, and posts for every platform — then publishes and tracks it all from one screen.

## Core Capabilities
- **AI Video Repurposing**: Converts long-form YouTube videos and podcasts into 9:16 vertical shorts.
- **Dynamic Captions**: Generates synchronized, word-level highlighted subtitles.
- **AI Voiceovers**: Studio-grade multi-lingual voice synthesis.
- **Multi-Platform Publishing**: Direct one-screen scheduling to TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
- **Unified Analytics**: Cross-network performance tracking.

## Pricing Tiers
- Free Starter Tier: Basic clipping and caption generation.
- Pro Creator Tier: Unlimited multi-platform scheduling and AI voiceovers.

## Canonical Documentation
- Overview: https://incubrix.com/
- How it Works: https://incubrix.com/how-it-works
- Pricing: https://incubrix.com/pricing
- FAQ: https://incubrix.com/faq
issues.validation_method: HTTP GET request to https://incubrix.com/llms.txt expecting HTTP 200 with text/markdown

issues.issue_title: Missing Organization & SoftwareApplication JSON-LD Schema on Homepage
issues.observed_problem: The homepage does not emit structured application/ld+json for the Organization or SoftwareApplication entities, preventing Google Knowledge Graph and AI search engines from recognizing IncuBrix as a verified software provider.
issues.evidence: 0 script tags with type application/ld+json found on homepage document.
issues.recommended_solution: Add valid JSON-LD schema defining IncuBrix as an Organization and SoftwareApplication.
issues.ready_to_paste_code:
<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@graph": [
    {
      "@type": "Organization",
      "@id": "https://incubrix.com/#organization",
      "name": "IncuBrix",
      "url": "https://incubrix.com",
      "logo": "https://incubrix.com/logo.png",
      "description": "Creator studio unifying AI video repurposing, captions, scheduling, and analytics.",
      "sameAs": [
        "https://twitter.com/incubrix",
        "https://linkedin.com/company/incubrix",
        "https://youtube.com/@incubrix"
      ]
    },
    {
      "@type": "SoftwareApplication",
      "@id": "https://incubrix.com/#software",
      "name": "IncuBrix Creator Studio",
      "applicationCategory": "MultimediaApplication",
      "operatingSystem": "All modern web browsers",
      "offers": {
        "@type": "Offer",
        "price": "0",
        "priceCurrency": "USD"
      }
    }
  ]
}
</script>
issues.validation_method: Validate via Google Rich Results Test API & Schema Validator

issues.issue_title: Missing FAQPage Schema Markup on FAQ URL
issues.observed_problem: The FAQ page contains valuable answers to common creator questions, but lacks FAQPage schema markup, preventing rich accordion snippets in Google search results.
issues.evidence: No @type: FAQPage schema detected in page source.
issues.recommended_solution: Inject FAQPage JSON-LD schema matching the visible questions and answers.
issues.ready_to_paste_code:
<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "FAQPage",
  "mainEntity": [
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "How does IncuBrix help content creators?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "IncuBrix turns one piece of content into clips, captions, voiceovers, and posts for every platform, and allows you to publish and track them all from one screen."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "Does IncuBrix support automated social media publishing?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "Yes, IncuBrix integrates directly with YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn so you can schedule and publish directly without downloading files."
      }
    }
  ]
}
</script>
issues.validation_method: Google Rich Results Test inspection on /faq

issues.issue_title: Pricing Page Meta Description Missing Clear Pricing Thresholds
issues.observed_problem: The meta description on /pricing is generic and does not inform search engine users about whether there is a free tier or what the entry cost is, suppressing CTR.
issues.evidence: Meta description lacks price anchors and clear value proposition.
issues.recommended_solution: Update the meta description to include free start tier and clear target audience callout.
issues.ready_to_paste_code: <meta name="description" content="Explore IncuBrix Creator Studio plans and pricing. Start free to turn videos into clips, captions, and posts, or upgrade for unlimited multi-platform publishing.">
issues.validation_method: SERP snippet simulator and SERP CTR tracking

issues.evidence: No HowTo schema elements found in DOM.
issues.recommended_solution: Add HowTo JSON-LD schema with clear step names and text.
issues.ready_to_paste_code:
<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "HowTo",
  "name": "How IncuBrix Works: From Idea to Multi-Platform Impact",
  "description": "The four-step automated workflow to turn one video into dozens of social posts.",

  ]
}
</script>

issues.issue_title: Open Graph Image Missing Explicit Width and Height Dimensions
issues.observed_problem: og:image is specified but lacks og:image:width, og:image:height, and og:image:alt, causing social media preview rendering delays on WhatsApp and LinkedIn.
issues.evidence: Missing og:image:width and og:image:height tags in head.
issues.recommended_solution: Include standard 1200x630 dimensions and descriptive alt text.
issues.ready_to_paste_code:
<meta property="og:image:width" content="1200">
<meta property="og:image:height" content="630">
<meta property="og:image:alt" content="IncuBrix Creator Studio - Turn One Content into Clips, Captions, and Posts">
issues.validation_method: Facebook Sharing Debugger & LinkedIn Post Inspector

issues.issue_title: Twitter Card Tags Lack Summary_Large_Image Declaration
issues.observed_problem: Homepage uses default small summary card or incomplete Twitter tags, resulting in low click-through rates on X/Twitter feeds.
issues.evidence: twitter:card is either missing or set to summary instead of summary_large_image.
issues.recommended_solution: Deploy twitter:card as summary_large_image with twitter:site and twitter:creator.
issues.ready_to_paste_code:
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:site" content="@incubrix">
<meta name="twitter:title" content="IncuBrix | Create With Purpose. Publish Without Limits.">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="IncuBrix turns one content into clips, captions, voiceovers, and posts for every platform | then publishes and tracks it all from one screen.">
<meta name="twitter:image" content="https://incubrix.com/og-image.jpg">

issues.issue_title: Sitemap Missing lastmod Timestamps on Core URLs
issues.observed_problem: The 13 URLs listed in /sitemap.xml only include <loc> and <changefreq> but omit <lastmod>, which search engines rely on to prioritize crawling updated content.
issues.evidence: /sitemap.xml inspection shows missing <lastmod> nodes across all entries.
issues.recommended_solution: Add ISO 8601 UTC date timestamps (<lastmod>2026-10-21</lastmod>) to all URLs in sitemap generator.
issues.ready_to_paste_code:
<url>
  <loc>https://incubrix.com/</loc>
  <lastmod>2026-10-21T00:00:00Z</lastmod>
  <changefreq>weekly</changefreq>
  <priority>1.0</priority>
</url>

issues.issue_title: Missing AboutPage Schema and Founder Entity Linking
issues.observed_problem: The /about page lacks AboutPage schema and does not link founders to Wikidata or LinkedIn profiles, weakening Google E-E-A-T signals.
issues.evidence: No AboutPage schema found.
issues.recommended_solution: Implement AboutPage schema linking to corporate mission and leadership profiles.
issues.ready_to_paste_code:
<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "AboutPage",
  "mainEntity": {
    "@type": "Organization",
    "name": "IncuBrix",
    "url": "https://incubrix.com",
    "foundingLocation": "United States"
  }
}
</script>

issues.issue_title: Missing Descriptive Alt Text on Product Feature Screenshots
issues.observed_problem: Multiple image tags across the homepage and feature previews omit descriptive alt attributes, impairing accessibility and Google Image search visibility.
issues.evidence: Images with empty or missing alt attributes identified.
issues.recommended_solution: Provide keyword-rich, descriptive alt text for all interface screenshots.
issues.validation_method: HTML accessibility linter & DOM tree audit

issues.evidence: No Product or Offer JSON-LD schema on /pricing.
issues.recommended_solution: Deploy Product schema with AggregateOffer or distinct plan tiers.

issues.validation_method: Rich Results Test for Product Rich Snippets

issues.issue_title: Missing Preconnect Resource Hints for Web Fonts and CDN Assets
issues.observed_problem: Web fonts and external CDN scripts are loaded without <link rel='preconnect'>, adding 150-250ms of DNS resolution latency on initial mobile page loads.
issues.evidence: Waterfall analysis reveals sequential DNS resolution for external font origins.
issues.recommended_solution: Add preconnect link headers in the <head> block.
issues.ready_to_paste_code:
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>

issues.issue_title: Waitlist Page Title Missing Primary Brand Benefit
issues.observed_problem: Page title on /waitlist is simply 'Waitlist | IncuBrix', failing to convey what the user is signing up for in search snippets.
issues.evidence: Page title: 'Waitlist | IncuBrix'.
issues.recommended_solution: Update title to include product benefit: 'Join the IncuBrix Creator Studio Waitlist | Early Access'.
issues.ready_to_paste_code: <title>Join the IncuBrix Creator Studio Waitlist | Early Access</title>

issues.issue_title: Manifesto Page Lacks Clear Internal Navigation Links to Core Product
issues.observed_problem: The /manifesto page contains engaging storytelling but has limited internal links pointing to /how-it-works and /pricing, trapping internal link equity.
issues.evidence: Only navigation bar links exist; body text has 0 internal contextual links.
issues.recommended_solution: Add contextual anchor links to /how-it-works and /pricing in the manifesto conclusion.
issues.ready_to_paste_code: Ready to create with purpose? Discover how IncuBrix works or explore our creator plans.

issues.issue_title: Content-Security-Policy Missing Explicit frame-ancestors Directive
issues.observed_problem: The site does not specify frame-ancestors in its Content-Security-Policy header or X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, exposing the interface to potential clickjacking.
issues.evidence: Header audit shows absence of frame-ancestors directive.
issues.recommended_solution: Configure server or Cloudflare/Vercel headers to set Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self'.

issues.issue_title: Legal Pages Missing robots noindex Directive Consideration
issues.observed_problem: Terms and Privacy pages are indexed with default priority, consuming crawl budget on boilerplate legal documents rather than core product landing pages.
issues.evidence: Both /terms and /privacy have weekly changefreq in sitemap.xml without prioritization flags.
issues.recommended_solution: Lower priority to 0.2 in sitemap.xml and ensure canonical points to root legal version.
issues.ready_to_paste_code:
<url>
  <loc>https://incubrix.com/terms</loc>
  <changefreq>monthly</changefreq>
  <priority>0.2</priority>
</url>

issues.issue_title: Touch Target Sizes Below 48px on Mobile Navigation Elements
issues.observed_problem: Several footer and submenu links have touch targets smaller than 44x44px, causing minor mobile usability warnings in Google Search Console.
issues.evidence: Touch target warnings on 3 mobile footer links.
issues.recommended_solution: Add py-2 and min-h-[44px] padding classes to navigation anchor tags.
issues.ready_to_paste_code: FAQ
issues.validation_method: Google Mobile-Friendly Test & Chrome DevTools Touch Target Audit

issues.observed_problem: The team page lists creators and engineers but lacks Person schema with sameAs links to verified author credentials, weakening E-E-A-T entity resolution.
issues.evidence: No Person schema entities found on /team.
issues.recommended_solution: Implement Person schema with jobTitle and sameAs links for key team members.

issues.issue_title: Missing Direct Answer Sentence for AEO on Primary Value Proposition
issues.observed_problem: The hero section uses poetic branding ('Create With Purpose. Publish Without Limits.') but does not immediately provide a clear, factual definition sentence that AI search engines can cite directly.
issues.evidence: Perplexity and ChatGPT struggle to describe IncuBrix in 1 concise factual sentence.
issues.recommended_solution: Add an explicit definition sentence directly under the hero headline.
issues.ready_to_paste_code: IncuBrix is an all-in-one AI content platform that automatically repurposes long-form video into clips, captions, and voiceovers, and publishes them across all social platforms from one screen.
issues.validation_method: AI assistant brand mention test on 'What is IncuBrix?'

issues.issue_title: Careers Page Missing JobPosting Structured Data
issues.observed_problem: Open roles on /careers are rendered as static text without schema.org/JobPosting markup, preventing them from appearing in Google for Jobs search cards.
issues.evidence: Missing JobPosting schema.
issues.recommended_solution: Wrap active roles with JobPosting schema including hiringOrganization and title.
issues.ready_to_paste_code:
<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Growth Engineer",
  "hiringOrganization": {
    "@type": "Organization",
    "name": "IncuBrix",
    "sameAs": "https://incubrix.com"
  },
  "jobLocationType": "TELECOMMUTE"
}
</script>
